scope: Exploratory mechanisms on reused development objects, not new independent-object evidence.

heat.scope: Two reused operator-development meshes, nine points each; same nodal heat factors. Direct off-grid eigensolutions use the same spectral rank, not an infinite-rank ground truth. No texture accuracy or speed claim.

previous_diagnostics.unit: four reused development objects; views and queries not independent objects
previous_diagnostics.selection: All four historical objects, the pre-existing partial/full colour controls, fixed tail k=24; chosen before these decompositions, after historical effects were known.
previous_diagnostics.render_scope: Recorded outputs only; pixel error identity is algebraic and is not a causal explanation, a renderer-Jacobian estimate or a deployable image-space oracle. Paired reference images were required to be exactly equal.

tail.scope: All saved fitting/validation/test queries pooled for descriptive mechanism analysis, not a held-out selection policy.

fixed_response_non_nesting.scope: Fixed-response bounded colours with shared background; not fully retrained model-class non-nesting.
fixed_response_non_nesting.proof: For any c in [-1,1]^5 and shared background, the preclip difference is (c1-c2)/4, at most 1/2. Clipping is 1-Lipschitz. Closest predictions to [1,0] with this separation are [3/4,1/4], attained here.

identity_verification.scope: Numerical checks of classical identities and counterexamples, not empirical generalization guarantees.
